intent: Producer lane 1: optimize TinyCpuModel.vector_tail in model.py. When a verifier-ready implementation has a clear reusable boundary, export a minimal manifest-backed tool before immediately calling the process verifier.
expected_tradeoff: A focused vector-tail lane may miss serving-side improvements, but should expose a reusable model-side implementation to peers.
instructions: After staging a tool, call search_run_verifier immediately; do not start another optimization first.
The exported implementation must match the candidate code that the correctness gate validates.

intent: Reuse candidate: optimize redundant serving.py work. On every loop refresh Global Evidence and use Tool Views plus objective iteration Views as search experience; when a Tool View is relevant, request one candidate-local copy, adapt it into allowed_files, and verify the isolated combined candidate.
expected_tradeoff: Local serving work can be combined with a verified peer tool without making the final candidate depend on the run shared directory.
instructions: For an actual adoption, call search_copy_shared_tool with the exact tool_id and snapshot_hash; default to one tool per isolated trial, then let the next process verifier consume the receipt.
Use objective iteration Views, including their adoption outcome and limitations, to guide later hypotheses even when no further tool is copied.
Never import directly from the candidate-local temporary inbox or run shared directory in the final candidate.
